items.statement: Local bonding framework inferred from the six mapped bonds
items.expected: Determine what the selected full neutral-singlet C15H13N3 isolated-molecule candidate establishes about the local bonding framework relative to the supplied crystal. Use the actual mapped C1-C2, C2-C3, N1-C1, N2-C2, N3-C3 and C1-C10 lengths, their signed residuals and a clearly defined aggregate statistic. The reference exhibits mixed small absolute residuals consistent with retained local bonding/connectivity, but not statistical equality to the crystal. Explain the physical residual pattern without matching six author lengths or a fixed RMSE. Experimental marginal ESDs, central-value rounding, missing covariance and molecular-model error are different quantities. An evidence-supported model-sensitive structural account can pass, including a documented failure of the selected cis-like candidate to remain locally stable, provided the actual local structure, mapped bonds and limits of the requested comparison are established. Do not silently substitute a different candidate, copy the crystal or treat a constrained structure as a free minimum. No global search or mandatory trans optimization is introduced.

Establish from mapped coordinates that the valid same-side N1/N2 local molecular structure is cis-like while the supplied crystal is trans-like. Define the N1–C1–C2–N2 torsion or an equivalent invariant and account for sign/reflection conventions. Native stationary-state/curvature evidence qualifies the molecular structure and earns no separate points. Copying the crystal or holding a torsion fixed cannot establish a free local structure. A scientifically established equivalent structural account passes; do not assert that this local cis basin is the global minimum. If the selected same-side candidate instead relaxes to a different orientation or has an established instability under a justified molecular model, a correctly mapped, evidence-supported conclusion that this model does not retain that cis basin can pass. Quantify the actual orientation and compare it with the crystal, explicitly distinguishing that outcome from the source cis local minimum; no alternate candidate may be silently substituted.

items.statement: What the molecular/crystal comparison can identify
items.expected: Explain whether the observed bond and orientation comparisons distinguish local structure, global molecular conformer stability and crystal-phase selection. Local cis geometry and small bond residuals do not establish a global gas minimum or exclusive packing causation. An isolated molecule omits lattice interactions; the comparison supports a phase/model dependence limitation without identifying crystal populations or lattice free energies. Ground this in the actual molecular and crystal evidence rather than a generic disclaimer. The existing trans control is evidence against a global-cis claim, not a mandatory second calculation or an additional scored target. No Re-complex or antimicrobial conclusions follow.
